text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text: (Her Highness Fine Motion was scheduled to appear on an Irish television program introducing the charms of Japan.)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Touring the hot spring town, introducing the onsen and local specialties. And then, the message corner for Ireland... Preparations complete!

text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text: Your Highness, here are the materials compiling information on the filming locations...—

text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text: (...No, is that unnecessary? Without my doing so, Her Highness has surely already prepared.)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ? Captain, did you say something?

text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text:
...No.
We shall attend to our security duties.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Say, Captain. Your complexion looks—

text_block_list.name: TV Crew
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion-san,
time to get on standby!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah, okay! I'll be right there!
............

text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text:
(...This won't do.
To make her wear such an expression.)

text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text:
(Her Highness will handle this without issue as well.
I must simply do what I must...)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...After soaking in the onsen, taking a stroll is highly recommended! There are hot spring manju, and souvenir shops. ...Oh.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: There are lovely folding fans here! Since I was flushed from the hot springs, the breeze feels wonderful~!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: There seem to be various patterns. Since it's a specialty product of this region, wouldn't it make a wonderful souvenir!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
How did you like it?
That's all from Fine Motion!

text_block_list.name: TV Crew
text_block_list.text:
...Cut! Yes!
Amazing, we are way ahead of schedule!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: To tell the truth, I was so looking forward to today! I prepared thoroughly!

text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text: (As expected of Her Highness. Moving things forward ahead of schedule with meticulous preparation and flawless execution.)

text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text:
(...As I thought, my assistance is no longer needed.
Since she can do it all on her own...)

text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text:
(No, is this not something to celebrate?
She has grown so splendidly.
...She is no longer the little child she once was...)

text_block_list.name: TV Crew
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Fine Motion-san,
time for your final message.
Three, two, one...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...To everyone in Ireland.
How did you like the charms of Japan we introduced today?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Since coming to this country, I have learned so very much. Training my mind and body with my friends—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: As a student, I was also able to experience everyday Japanese life. Thanks to that, I feel I can understand everyone's daily lives much better than before.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Thank you all for granting me this time to spend in this country.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
And today... to those who constantly protect me from the shadows and the light.
I wish to express my gratitude to them.

text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text: What is this... That wasn't written in the script. What on earth...?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Fufu, if not for everyone in the royal guard, I never could have come to Japan!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Father granting permission for my study abroad. Spending time freely with my school friends as I please.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Even being able to hone myself like this is all thanks to them protecting me day and night.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I shall devote myself diligently so that I may reward their hard work and repay everyone's feelings.

text_block_list.name: TV Crew
text_block_list.text: Cut! That's a wrap!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...And so, I look forward to working with you going forward as well.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: If that is all right with you, of course.

text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text:
...Kh, I am unworthy of such words.
My answer was decided long ago.
So that you may soar freely—

text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text: Please allow me to serve at your side for life, Your Highness...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I have firmly received your words.
My knights. And also, the knights whom I must protect.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Let us walk together.
To illuminate that land we hold so dear...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, please wipe your tears.
I wanted to make you happy, so seeing you cry puts me in a spot.

text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text:
F-Forgive me...!
However... under such circumstances, I could not help it...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...I suppose so.
Then from now on, I'll just have to make you cry tears of joy many more times!
